chunks: 1646 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say:

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: khums, the one-fifth due discussed here as a legal obligation
key_terms.الْغَنَائِمِ: spoils, the category to which khums is here restricted

ai.seo_question: According to this hadith, to what does khums specifically apply?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal statement from Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding the scope of khums. It states, in this wording, that khums applies specifically to spoils, making it a concise narration relevant to discussions of financial law in Shi'i fiqh.
